page.overview:
Who is Milleuda Folles?

Milleuda Folles, also known as Miluda Folles, is a swordmaiden of the rebel group Corpse Brigade in Final Fantasy Tactics. Her brother, Wiegraf, is the Brigade's leader, and she serves as one of his lieutenants, fighting at his side to defend Ivalice in the Fifty Years' War. Yet at war's end, the Crown failed to honor the commoners' valor with just recompense, giving them cause to rise against their former liege lords.

Milleuda fought Ramza Beoulve's band on two occasions. Ramza was a cadet at a military academy, and a noble of the renowned House Beoulve, and thus she viewed him as her enemy for his aristocracy. Ramza's group attacked her at the Brigands' Den in chapter 1, "The Meager", during which she argued with the ignorant and arrogant Argath Thadalfus fighting alongside Ramza, who accused her of being a godless animal because she was a peasant. When Milleuda was defeated, Argath urged Ramza to kill her, but Ramza's friend Delita Heiral, sympathizing with her because he, too, was a peasant, stayed Ramza's hand, and she limped away in disgrace.

The second battle took place at the Lenalian Plateau as Ramza and Delita attempted to rescue Delita's sister, Tietra Heiral, who had been abducted by the Corpse Brigade under assumption she is a noble. Despite Argath's absence, Milleuda was still convinced that Ramza was her enemy, even as he tried to convince her to stand down.

In the end, Ramza was forced to kill her. Her death marked the beginning of Ramza's fall from the Order of the Northern Sky, as it set off a chain of events that resulted in the Ziekden Fortress incident.
